color: rgb(14, 42, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Accepted facts only
each with its quote and who accepted it

div.style: color: rgb(11, 61, 39) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
compile
canonical order · people · tasks · routes ·
things · permits · commitments · conditions

div.style: color: rgb(11, 61, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
evaluate
every due date × every route × every person who could do it
access (holder, shares, containers, prerequisites) · valid permits ·
conditions · free time windows · willingness
three-valued: true / false / unknown

div.style: color: rgb(58, 38, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Five states with a date and a reason
ready · handover not finished · needs a check ·
blocked · nothing due while away

div.style: color: rgb(11, 61, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
discover
still needed while away · held by the person leaving ·
clash · deadline · not asked · sources disagree

div.style: color: rgb(58, 38, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
knockout: re-run the absence as if
this thing were still available.
Does the outcome change?

div.style: color: rgb(58, 38, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Finding kept, with the dates
and the facts behind it

div.style: color: rgb(60, 86, 94) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Set aside, and shown,
with the reason

div.style: color: rgb(29, 29, 92) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Gemini reviewer: uphold, narrow
(citing the finding's own facts) or ask

div.style: color: rgb(93, 24, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Code checks the citations;
the reviewer can't add findings or change numbers

div.style: color: rgb(11, 61, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
repair
typed steps with effects (ASK, ASK_SWAP, SHARE_CONTACT,
LEAVE_WITH, SETUP_ACCESS, RENEW_EARLY, PRACTICE…)
grouped into bundles per task and person

div.style: color: rgb(11, 61, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Exhaustive search of bundle combinations within the time budget
most dates covered → most weight ready → lightest busiest person →
fewest minutes; ties broken the same way every time

div.style: color: rgb(58, 38, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The plan: N minutes gets X of Y ready,
minutes per person, and what stays open

div.style: color: rgb(14, 42, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Evidence recorded by a person
applies the same typed effects
